title: Replace DSE name with Salesman Name and add Retailer Name column in final report

requirements.summary: Replace 'DSE name' column header with 'Salesman Name' in reports export
acceptanceCriteria: The exported CSV/XLSX report shows 'Salesman Name' instead of 'DSE name' in the column header
The salesman data in the column remains unchanged, only the header label is updated

file_operations.description: Update the CSV header generation to replace 'DSE name' with 'Salesman Name' in the column definitions. Locate the header array that includes 'DSE name' and change it to 'Salesman Name' while preserving all other headers and the data mapping logic.

requirements.summary: Add 'Retailer Name' column to the final report export
acceptanceCriteria: The exported report includes a new 'Retailer Name' column
The retailer name is populated correctly for each payment entry row
The column is positioned appropriately within the existing report structure

file_operations.description: Add 'Retailer Name' column to the report export. Insert the column header in an appropriate position (likely near 'Retailer Code') and populate it by mapping payment entries to their corresponding retailer names from the invoices data. Use the existing retailerCode-to-name lookup pattern that appears to be used for DSE/salesman name mapping.
